description: Start a course export as a .imscc Common Cartridge or a zip of files. Canvas packages it in the background; poll get_content_export with the returned ID. export_course_archive does export and download in one step. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: create_content_export
title: Create Content Export
